req.title: Set cookie via path
req.statement: The system shall set a cookie of name=<name>, value=<value> and redirect to /cookies when GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> sets a cookie and issues a 302 redirect to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive path — correct 302 status, Set-Cookie header with exact name/value, Location header pointing to /cookies; (2) negative path — malformed or missing path segments; (3) boundary cases — single-character name/value, special characters, empty-like values. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (302 not 301/303), exact Location header value, exact cookie name and value in Set-Cookie header, and verifying the redirect target is precisely /cookies.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No pre-existing cookies in test client
trace: R-HTTPBIN-030: set cookie via path -> 302 redirect to /cookies with Set-Cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/testname/testvalue', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies' or location.endswith('/cookies')
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'testname=testvalue' in set_cookie

test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_redirect_target_exact
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Assert Location header ends with /cookies (not /cookies/set or /get)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-030: redirect target must be /cookies, not any other path
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_redirect_target_exact():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/mykey/myval', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location.endswith('/cookies'), f'Expected /cookies, got {location}'
    assert not location.endswith('/cookies/set'), 'Should not redirect back to /cookies/set'
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'mykey=myval' in set_cookie

test_set_cookie_via_path_redirect_target_exact()

import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_follow_redirect_cookie_visible():

    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Verify both cookies appear in /cookies JSON
expected: Final /cookies JSON contains first=one and second=two
trace: R-HTTPBIN-030: each call sets its own cookie; state transition from no-cookie to multi-cookie
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_multiple_distinct_cookies():
    client.get('/cookies/set/first/one', follow_redirects=True)
    client.get('/cookies/set/second/two', follow_redirects=True)
    r = client.get('/cookies')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert data['cookies'].get('first') == 'one'
    assert data['cookies'].get('second') == 'two'
